parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols isis net 10.0000.0000.0001.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的网络实体标题（NET）。

parameters.name: net
parameters.explanation: IS-IS网络实体标题，用于标识IS-IS路由域中的设备。

set protocols isis frr level-1 loop-free.template: set protocols isis frr level-1 loop-free-alternate
set protocols isis frr level-1 loop-free.command: set protocols isis frr level-1 loop-free-alternate
set protocols isis frr level-1 loop-free.explanation: 在IS-IS协议的level-1中启用快速重路由（FRR）的无环替代路径功能。

set protocols isis frr level-2 loop-free.template: set protocols isis frr level-2 loop-free-alternate
set protocols isis frr level-2 loop-free.command: set protocols isis frr level-2 loop-free-alternate
set protocols isis frr level-2 loop-free.explanation: 在IS-IS协议的level-2中启用快速重路由（FRR）的无环替代路径功能。

set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0 ne.command: set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0 network-type point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0 ne.explanation: 配置IS-IS接口的网络类型为点对点。

set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1 ne.command: set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1 network-type point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1 ne.explanation: 配置IS-IS接口的网络类型为点对点。

set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1 me.command: set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/1 metric 30

parameters.name: metric
parameters.explanation: 接口的度量值，用于路由计算。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
